title: WaveAttestationEnvelope
description: WAVE Attestation Standard v1 wire envelope. Carried as the `wave.attestation` OTLP span attribute (JSON string). See ATTESTATION-STANDARD-v1.md for the normative specification.

subject.description: Kind-specific payload. For 'render' kind, see the RenderAttestationSubject definition.

alg.description: Signature algorithm. 'ed25519' or 'none'. Invariant: alg === 'none' ⟺ sig === null.

sig.description: Base64url-encoded Ed25519 signature over canonicalJson(subject) bytes. null when alg is 'none'.

oneOf.description: ISO 8601 timestamp or unix seconds as string.

then.description: When alg is 'none', sig must be null.

else.description: When alg is not 'none', sig must be present and a non-null string.

RenderAttestationSubject.title: RenderAttestationSubject
RenderAttestationSubject.description: Subject payload for kind='render'. Frozen by ATTESTATION-STANDARD-v1.md §3.1.

v.description: Must equal the envelope v field.

scene_sha256.description: SHA-256 hex of the canonical scene input.

output_sha256.description: SHA-256 hex of the rendered output bytes.

bytes.description: Byte length of the rendered output.

ContextAttestationSubject.title: ContextAttestationSubject
ContextAttestationSubject.description: Minimal subject payload for kind='context'. Services may extend with additional fields.

SettlementAttestationSubject.title: SettlementAttestationSubject
SettlementAttestationSubject.description: Minimal subject payload for kind='settlement'. Settlement services define the full schema.
